children.innerHTML: Onboarding isn't one day, it's a sequence. Primer covers the three phases where it usually falls apart.
The week before a start date is admin quicksand. Primer runs it: accounts, laptop, intros, all fired from one trigger.

Repo access on day zero, a scoped first ticket, and a deploy before the week is out. Docs linked at the moment they matter.
Call recordings ordered by deal stage, a shadow schedule, and a first pitch with training wheels. Ramp measured in weeks, not quarters.
Finance, design, support, ops. If the role has a first week, it gets a path. The everyone-else template covers the common 80%.
